model.bloch_convention: u_(m+q)=exp(i q k_x)u_m; stored total_x equals q k_x and total_y equals q k_y
model.fiber_equation: u_(m+1)+u_(m-1)+2 lambda cos(k_y+2 pi p m/q)u_m=E u_m
model.lattice_operator: horizontal hopping 1 and vertical hopping lambda in Landau gauge exp(2 pi i p m/q)
model.parameter_domain: gcd(p,q)=1, q>=3, lambda>0; q=1,2 are direct boundary fibers

nonclaims: no claim that every Harper gap is open
no Chern-number, gap-labelling, edge-state, or quantized-transport theorem
no irrational-flux Cantor-spectrum or Ten-Martini theorem
no novelty or priority claim for Harper, Chambers, Hofstadter, or Lamoureux-Mingo results
no target Euler factor, root number, automorphy, target-zero match, or Hilbert-Polya operator

proof_receipts.duality_owner: magnetic Fourier transform and axis exchange, followed by energy scaling
proof_receipts.even_central_source: Lamoureux-Mingo Theorem 2.5 and Corollary 2.6 with lambda_LM=2 lambda give P(0); even parity gives P'(0)=0
proof_receipts.extreme_coefficients: coprimality makes both extreme phase coefficients exactly -lambda^q
proof_receipts.phase_support: cyclic conjugacy under k_y shift 2 pi p/q leaves only Fourier modes 0 and plus or minus q
proof_receipts.real_edge_factors: P-C and P+C are characteristic polynomials of the endpoint fibers at total phases (0,0) and (pi,pi)
proof_receipts.spectrum_range: the independent cosine sum fills the entire closed phase interval

theorem_contract.chambers_identity: det(EI-H_fiber)=P_(p/q,lambda)(E)-2 cos(q k_x)-2 lambda^q cos(q k_y)
theorem_contract.edge_criterion: band-edge multiset solves P^2=4(1+lambda^q)^2; a multiple edge solves that equation together with P'=0
theorem_contract.edge_fiber_realization: P-C=det(EI-H(0,0)) and P+C=det(EI-H(pi/q,pi/q)); both endpoint fibers are real symmetric
theorem_contract.even_central_contact: for even q, P(0)=2(-1)^(q/2)(1+lambda^q) and P'(0)=0
theorem_contract.spectrum_preimage: the full two-dimensional spectrum is P inverse of [-2(1+lambda^q),2(1+lambda^q)]

tolerances.exact_lane: zero in Q[zeta_q]/Phi_q for every reduced q<=10 and symbolic lambda
